claim wallets-F1: Creating a wallet returns 201 with the owner, currency USD by default, and balance and held both "0.00".
claim wallets-F2: Currency must be one of USD, EUR, EGP or AED; anything else returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with field "currency".
claim wallets-F3: Owner is required: a blank owner returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with field "owner".
claim wallets-F4: Owner names longer than 80 characters are rejected.
claim wallets-F5: Spaces around the owner name are trimmed before saving.
claim wallets-F6: A deposit adds the amount and returns 201 with the wallet id and the new balance as a two-decimal string.
claim wallets-F7: Deposits follow the same amount rules as transfers: zero returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
claim wallets-F8: GET /wallets/:id returns the wallet with balance and held; a malformed or unknown id returns 404 WALLET_NOT_FOUND.
claim transfers-F1: A transfer below the review threshold completes immediately: 201, status "completed", and money values come back as strings with two decimals.
claim transfers-F2: The fee is 0.5% of the amount, rounded to cents.
claim transfers-F3: The fee never goes below 1.00, so any transfer under 200.00 pays exactly 1.00.
claim transfers-F4: Transfers of 5,000.00 or more are not settled; they are created with status "pending_review". 4,999.99 still completes.
claim transfers-F5: A pending_review transfer charges the sender amount plus fee right away and moves the amount into the sender's "held" balance; the receiver is not credited.
claim transfers-F6: The receiver of a pending_review transfer sees no change to their balance.
claim transfers-F7: A completed transfer takes amount plus fee from the sender and gives the receiver the amount only.
claim transfers-F8: Each wallet can send at most 10,000.00 per UTC day. Going over returns 422 LIMIT_EXCEEDED with the amount still allowed in "remaining".
claim transfers-F9: Pending_review transfers count toward the daily limit.
claim transfers-F10: The daily limit is checked before the balance: a wallet with no money that asks for more than the limit gets LIMIT_EXCEEDED, not INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.
claim transfers-F11: The sender must cover amount plus fee; otherwise 409 INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS. A balance of 100.99 cannot send 100.00.
claim transfers-F12: Repeating a request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original transfer with 200 and the header Idempotent-Replay: true, without moving money again.
claim transfers-F13: A reused Idempotency-Key returns the original transfer even when the new request asks for a different amount.
claim transfers-F14: Sender and receiver must use the same currency; otherwise 422 CURRENCY_MISMATCH.
claim transfers-F15: Sending to the same wallet returns 400 SAME_WALLET.
claim transfers-F16: Amount must be a JSON number above 0 with at most 2 decimals; strings, zero, negatives and extra decimals return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with field "amount".
claim transfers-F17: Wallet ids must be UUIDs; anything else returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the field.
claim transfers-F18: A well-formed wallet id that does not exist returns 404 WALLET_NOT_FOUND.
claim transfers-F19: GET /transfers/:id returns the transfer as created; an unknown id returns 404 TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND.
